main_text.l: & alia ejusdem naturæ, quæ prætereo, Fran-
pos, uti loquuntur, seu Patronus, biblio-
commisit. Is erat Josephus Maria Sua-
resius, qui postea factus est Episcopus Vas-
Romanorum ingenio, qui de Morini opere
nis suæ, qui Romæ degebant, variasqve ad
eum dedit literas, quæ illi pergratæ
fuerunt. Scripsit qvoqve operis sui apolo-
ciscum Barperinum, cujus animum a se

page.notes: Printed "Barperinum" is probably a misprint for "Barberinum" (the name appears as "Barberinus" earlier on the page); left as printed. The word "ficio" on the last line is the second half of "officio", set right-aligned after the hyphen; it is part of the text, not a catchword. The second "ficio" in the text above is a transcription artefact of that line break; the printed text reads "meminitqve of-" then "ficio". Printed "Ne-pos" and "Suaresius" with a long s look like "f" in the scan; read as s. "Morini" appears as "Morini" on the line with "ope-re".
